thread.title: Apple Loses Trillion Dollar Company Status Due to 10% Slide on Stock Market Since Thursday

author: Joe Rossignol
title: Apple Loses Trillion Dollar Company Status Due to 10% Slide on Stock Market Since Thursday
text: Apple Loses Trillion Dollar Company Status Due to 10% Slide on Stock Market Since Thursday By Joe Rossignol Nov 5, 2018, 12:23 pm 18 pts AAPL has dipped below the $200 mark at times today, and is down around 10 percent since Apple's earnings report last week, resulting in the company losing its trillion dollar valuation in terms of market capitalization. As of writing, Apple has a market cap of around $950 billion based on its latest…
